A Tree child that draws no rows takes no place among its siblings' guides (rich-animation-42lg.8qh) (#491)

* A Tree child that draws no rows takes no place among its siblings' guides (rich-animation-42lg.8qh)

The walk now draws each label before it chooses the branch, so the last
child that draws a row ends it. A label yielding only carriers (a frameAt
frame of no cells) draws no row and still passes its nextChange on.
measure and contents read the same walk.

* Tree: branch on a subtree's first drawn row; render and measure draw labels one way (rich-animation-42lg.8qh review)

* Tree.measure: a label wants at least one column, so a label of no width keeps its row (rich-animation-42lg.8qh review)

* Tree.measure draws only a label of no width to ask if it draws; splitRows tested; docs say subtree (rich-animation-42lg.8qh review)
